constitutional_invariants: Always transpose raw camera buffers according to EXIF tag 0x0112 before projecting textures or generating thumbnails.
Never mutate or delete original vault raw files (.ARW, .CR3, .BRAW); emit sidecar .notary.json envelopes.
Use RFC 6962 domain-separated prefix bytes (0x00 leaf, 0x01 internal node) to prevent second-preimage Merkle collisions.

mcp_tool_definition.name: notarize_and_scrub_media
mcp_tool_definition.description: Compute RFC 6962 Merkle provenance receipt and scrub sensitive GPS/serial EXIF fields while preserving optical camera intrinsics.

multi_agent_synthesis_recipe: Stage 1 (Ingest): Read binary stream in 4KB blocks and extract EXIF/TIFF IFD0 & SubIFD tags.
Stage 2 (Transpose & Scrub): Apply EXIF_ORIENTATION_MATRICES[tag] and strip GPS/Serial keys.
Stage 3 (Attest): Compute SHA-256 + RFC 6962 Merkle root and bind to normalized metadata digest.
